request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: On 1 December 2026, for Annex IV categories of Directive 2006/42/EC built to harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements, the manufacturer may use internal checks on manufacture alone. For which of those categories is internal production control (module A) no longer admitted on 1 February 2027, even when harmonised standards are fully applied?

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards", "Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices", "Vehicle servicing lifts", "Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery"], "text": "Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, Article 25(3) and Annex I, Part A, these four categories (all from Directive 2006/42/EC Annex IV points 14, 15, 16 and 18) must use module B+C, H or G, so internal production control (module A) is not available for them even with harmonised standards applied. The Regulation applies from 14 January 2027 (Article 54), so this holds on 1 February 2027. The files contain no 1 December 2026 rule.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 25(3)", "quote": "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer ... shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) ... (b) EU type-examination (module B) ... followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) ...; (c) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) ...; (d) conformity based on unit verification (module G)"}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A", "quote": "PART A Categories of machinery or related products to which a procedure referred to in Article 25(2) shall be applied: 1. Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards. 2. Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices. 3. Vehicle servicing lifts. 4. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery."}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Annex IV", "quote": "14. Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards. 15. Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices. 16. Vehicle servicing lifts. 17. Devices for the lifting of persons ... 18. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Article 54 Entry into force and application", "quote": "It shall apply from 14 January 2027."}]}
